### Final-year research: iron biofortification with hydroponics

Grew mukunuwenna and kangkung in NFT and coconut-coir systems at three iron levels and ran the
biochemical assays. Project mark **84%** (supervisor's report 88%, report 85%, oral 79%).
Coconut coir raised iron in mukunuwenna 3.7-fold. [Project](projects/iron-biofortification/)
